title: Toyota Automobile Museum to Hold the 36th Classic Car Festival on 15 November, 2026
summary: This is a page ofThe 36th Toyota Automobile Museum Classic Car Festival
body_markdown:
Parade starts


Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park (Moricoro Park)


The Toyota Automobile Museum, a cultural facility of Toyota Motor Corporation, will host its **36th Classic Car Festival on Sunday, 15 November at Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park in Nagakute City, Aichi.** The community-based event aims to promote and sustain automobile culture.


The festival will offer a wide variety of programs. **In addition to a public road parade of approximately 120 privately owned classic cars from Japan, the U.S., and Europe, there will be an exhibition and driving demonstration featuring cars from the museum’s collection and those provided by seven Japanese automakers.** There will also be a display of specialty work vehicles.The street parade will start at the museum and travel about 12 kilometers through Nagakute City. Spectators will cheer on this seasonal event along the route to Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park, which is celebrating its 20th anniversary this year. A Toyota 2000GT Roadster will lead the parade.


**Festival Theme: “The Widening** **Web** **of Automobile Culture”** The festival aims to transcend generations, geographic boundaries, and circles of car enthusiasts. Through this theme, we hope to foster connections among attendees and encourage them to share their appreciation of automobile culture. We hope the event will bring joy to all, including not only car experts and enthusiasts, but also those who rarely come into contact with cars, let alone classic ones. Visitors will enjoy spending time with family and friends while viewing brightly colored classic cars and conversing with their owners. This experience will hopefully spark new interests and discoveries, ensuring the continued growth of automobile culture. ****


**Summary of the festival events:**


Date **Sunday, 15 November** (free admission), rain or shine
* Some events may be subject to change in the event of rain or other unforeseen circumstances.


Time 9:00–16:00


Venue Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park (Moricoro Park)
* The parade’s starting ceremony will take place at the Toyota Automobile Museum at 8:30.


Participating vehicles about 120 privately owned cars, 11 exhibition vehicles, etc.


**Program details**


**Classic car parade**


(08:30–10:45)


About 120 privately owned cars from Japan, the U.S., and Europe from 1996 or earlier will parade through 12 kilometers of public roads in Nagakute City.


8:30 Starting ceremony at the Toyota Automobile Museum


8:45 Cars start parading towards Moricoro Park


10:45 Parade ends


Toyota Automobile Museum―Waki intersection―Ichigahora intersection―Iwasaki Takenoyama Kita intersection―Yokomichi―Nagakute Onsen Gozarasse―Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park


**Vehicle exhibition**


(09:00–16:00)


About 120 privately owned cars will be on display after the parade.


The Walk and Talk with the museum director (13:30–14:00) will feature interactions with parade car owners and information on their vehicles.


The parade car owners will mingle with the museum staff as part of the Sunday Afternoon of Encounters (13:30–14:30) event.

**Broadcasting**


– Same-day streaming
For those who cannot attend the venue, the festival will be streamed on the day of the event. (Details will be announced later on the museum’s official website.)


– Streaming at a later date
The parade and the events at the venue will be streamed at a later date on the museum’s official YouTube channel.[Toyota Automobile Museum’s official YouTube channel](https://www.youtube.com/c/ToyotaAutomobileMuseum)


**Getting to the venue**


**Please use public transportation such as Linimo as traffic is expected to be heavy on the day of the event.**


– Park-and-ride
A temporary parking lot (up to 300 cars, free of charge) will be available on the south side of the museum. From there, walk four minutes to Geidai-Dori Station and take the Linimo to Expo 2005 Aichi Commemorative Park Station.


*** Holders of a valid one-day Linimo ticket are entitled to free admission to the Toyota Automobile Museum as well as discounts at the museum shop, etc.**
